reviews.title: Needs more refinement.  Can’t sync with other band members while using.
reviews.text:
1. No synchronization between band members. We should be able to sync multiple iPads so everyone can follow the same song, lyrics, and chord changes in real time. This is a major missing feature for live performances.

2. Duplicate songs in setlists. The app allows you to add the same song to a setlist multiple times without any warning. It should recognize songs already in a setlist and prevent accidental duplicates or at least alert you.

3. Count-in flexibility. We need the ability to enable or disable the count-in for individual songs, rather than relying on a global setting. Some songs need a count-in, while others should start immediately. This is especially important during live performances.

4. Inconsistent backing-track quality. Some tracks have artificial-sounding bass, guitars, and vocals that don’t resemble real instruments. For a paid subscription, the recording quality should be more consistent.

Jamzone has great potential for working musicians, but these aren’t minor conveniences. They’re important features for bands using the app professionally. I’d love to see more focus on real-world live performance needs, especially given the subscription cost.

reviews.title: Could be the best app in the universe - but…
reviews.text: Hi - you have entered password hell.  I use this app on my older iPad and it works great, but, I downloaded it on my iMac M4 Desktop and it insisted I set up a new account.  Upon doing this, all of my playlists vanished.  The Jam Zone app did not recognize my account.  I jumped through hoops attempting to contact support - forget it.  They say they’re in Massachusetts, USA, but they might as well be on the dark side of a moon in another galaxy.  Connectivity issues also hamper using the Pro level for anything.  I sure don’t want to delete my account, but I may have to.

reviews.title: Could be better.
reviews.text:
Three things that will make this app perfect.

MIDI Send, so we could trigger effect changes, lighting or really synchronize any external device that accepts midi commands. 

Also having the ability to add my own songs for original bands.

And, I would prefer to buy the app and individual songs rather than a subscription. (For a reasonable price of course)

reviews.title: Love/Dislike
reviews.text: I ‘m a new user. I’ve barely an intermediate guitar player-just singing and playing my instrument for personal enjoyment. Love my new band in an app, backup band, but I am troubled by the chords. I have been playing some songs 50 years and the chords are not matching my sheet music, song books, and some experience. It is troublesome. Yes, I can play a different chord, it sounds slightly different, but I can’t intuitively plan the song because it surprises me in different places with the cord changes. If I play a new song it is not particularly troublesome. But 60 years of playing with chord change ups, while the screen is racing by is a lot, disruptive, irritating, and causes me to wonder if a similar product may have similar problems. Support response has been quick as I have encountered these issues. I asked, if you could replace/change chords in a displayed songs. Answer was,no. I just have to either live with 60 years of a chord pattern or this app changed chord progression.

reviews.title: No sound, no support
reviews.text: I installed this and... no sound. Nothing comes through my Apollo interface no matter the settings I try. Every single other thing on my computer that makes sound comes through fine. I reached out to them a while ago and even though I bought a subscription, no help. Unistalled, reinstalled. Restarted computer. Did all the things. Prayed to the gods. I never heard anything back from them. This is of no use to me if I can't hear it. I could look past the terrible user interface if it worked.

No explanation just a sarcastic email saying we will try and collect it again over the next 4 days. Nope failed checked with bank again no problem my end. So sorry you get a one star, please bear in mind the faf I have had contacting my bank in the little spare time I have.
